text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and produce results that often look surprisingly human. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. People create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination, while AI simply recognises patterns and follows instructions. This raises interesting questions: can a machine truly be creative, or is it just copying what humans have already made? Many people believe AI is a helpful tool, but real creativity still comes from the human mind and heart.
